source_evidence: Before you engage an investment professional or purchase securities, make sure you research and verify all information.
answer: Before working with an investment professional, research and verify their information rather than relying only on what they tell you. IAPD provides information about SEC- and state-registered investment advisers, including registration status, fees, conflicts of interest, and disciplinary history. BrokerCheck provides background information on FINRA-registered brokers and brokerage firms, including employment history and regulatory or disciplinary events. You can also research professional designations and contact your state securities regulator for additional information.
